zh.principle: **算法**：SLH-DSA 状态哈希签名（SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+) stateless hash-based signature algorithm）。留存 FIPS 205 文本在 Abstract 段定名：「This standard specifies the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA).」§3 给出构造骨架：「SLH-DSA is a stateless hash-based signature scheme that is constructed using other hash-based signature schemes as components:」并列出两类组件——「a few-time signature scheme, forest of random subsets (FORS), and (2) a multi-time signature scheme, the eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme (XMSS).」原理即此：SLH-DSA 以少次签名 FORS 与多次签名 XMSS（后者又建于一次性签名 WOTS+）为构件，组合成一个无状态、以哈希为基的数字签名。该条目据算法在标准文本里的自述立论，与记述该出版物的 fips205 标准记录相区别。
zh.why: §1.1 说明它与既有签名的区别及理由：「Unlike the algorithms specified in FIPS 186-5 [1], SLH-DSA is designed to provide resistance against attacks from a large-scale quantum computer.」即相较于经典数字签名标准，它是为抗量子攻击而设计。其同段给出安全前提：「The security of the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA) relies on the presumed difficulty of finding preimages for hash functions」——其安全归于哈希原像的困难性。Abstract 补上来源：「SLH-DSA is based on SPHINCS+, which was selected for standardization as part of the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization process.」理由链因此是：经典签名在量子下失效，而以哈希原像困难为基础、无状态、由 SPHINCS+ 标准化的方案可提供量子抗力。措辞是 presumed difficulty，不作证明性断言。
zh.used: 使用约束在编号小节，措辞层级分明。§3.2 对组件外泄给出 should not：「As WOTS+, XMSS, FORS, and hypertree signature schemes are not approved for use as stand-alone signature schemes, cryptographic modules should not make interfaces to these components available to applications.」即组件仅用于拼出 SLH-DSA，模块不宜把它们做成对外接口。§3.1 对算术给出 shall not：「Implementations of SLH-DSA shall not use floating-point arithmetic, as rounding errors in floating point operations may lead to incorrect results in some cases.」——实现不得用浮点运算，理由是舍入误差可能致错。用途面貌因此是把 SLH-DSA 作整体签名方案使用，组件不作独立接口对外（should not），算术须避免浮点（shall not）。should not 与 shall not 在此不可互换。
zh.broken: 留存文本自陈的限度在实现与前提两面。§3.2 记侧信道与故障攻击敞口：「Care must be taken to protect implementations against attacks, such as side-channel attacks or fault attacks [17, 18, 19, 20, 21].」即私钥保密性关键，实现须防侧信道与故障提取。前提侧的限度见 why 段所引：其安全系于哈希原像之 presumed difficulty，而非归约到已被普遍接受的困难问题的证明。故被承认的脆弱来自实现（侧信道/故障）与假设（哈希抗力），而非标准文本给出的对 SLH-DSA 本身的攻破。§3.1 那句 shall-not 浮点限制（见 used 段）也属此类——它约束的是正确性，非攻击结果，该条目据文本如实记录，不作`已被破解`的断言。
zh.history: §1.2 交代它与候选版本的沿革。先记遴选：「After three rounds of evaluation and analysis, NIST selected the first four algorithms for standardization.」再记本标准对第三轮版本的关系：「This standard contains several minor modifications compared to Version 3 [4], which was submitted at the beginning of round three of the NIST PQC Standardization process.」并给出改名约定：「Throughout this standard, SPHINCS+ will be referred to as SLH-DSA for stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm.」门面板块（Title block）印标题 Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard 与 Published: August 13, 2024 Effective: August 13, 2024。据此，该条目所述算法是 SPHINCS+ 定稿后的标准形态 SLH-DSA，与记述该出版物的 fips205 记录分列，二者不互相作为别名。

zh.example:
**形式模型与复算步骤**

\[s=k^{-1}\big(H(m)+r d\big)\bmod n\]

SLH-DSA 状态哈希签名的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：k 一次性随机数，r 为承诺点横坐标，d 私钥，n 子群阶。1.选择随机 k，计算 R=kG 与 r。2.计算 s=k^{-1}(H(m)+rd) mod n。3.输出 (r,s)，验证者检查签名方程。边界：公式只覆盖已登记的参数与假设；参数取值、标准版本和实现细节仍以来源为准。

en.principle: **Algorithm**: SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+) stateless hash-based signature algorithm (SLH-DSA 状态哈希签名). The retained FIPS 205 text names it in the Abstract: "This standard specifies the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA)." Section 3 gives the construction skeleton: "SLH-DSA is a stateless hash-based signature scheme that is constructed using other hash-based signature schemes as components:" and lists the two kinds — "a few-time signature scheme, forest of random subsets (FORS), and (2) a multi-time signature scheme, the eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme (XMSS)." The principle is that SLH-DSA composes a few-time FORS scheme and a multi-time XMSS scheme (itself built on the one-time WOTS+) into a stateless, hash-based digital signature. This dossier rests on the algorithm's own description inside the standard text and is kept distinct from the fips205 standard record, which documents the publication.
en.why: Section 1.1 states how it differs from the existing signatures and why: "Unlike the algorithms specified in FIPS 186-5 [1], SLH-DSA is designed to provide resistance against attacks from a large-scale quantum computer." unlike the classical signature standard, it is designed for quantum resistance. The same paragraph gives the security premise: "The security of the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA) relies on the presumed difficulty of finding preimages for hash functions" its safety rests on hash-preimage hardness. The abstract adds the origin: "SLH-DSA is based on SPHINCS+, which was selected for standardization as part of the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization process." The chain of reasons is therefore that classical signatures fail under quantum computing, while a stateless scheme grounded in hash-preimage hardness and standardized from SPHINCS+ can provide quantum resistance. The wording is presumed difficulty, not a proof.
en.used: The usage constraints sit in the numbered sections at distinct wording levels. Section 3.2 puts component exposure at should not: "As WOTS+, XMSS, FORS, and hypertree signature schemes are not approved for use as stand-alone signature schemes, cryptographic modules should not make interfaces to these components available to applications." the components serve only to build SLH-DSA, so modules should not expose them as application interfaces. Section 3.1 puts arithmetic at shall not: "Implementations of SLH-DSA shall not use floating-point arithmetic, as rounding errors in floating point operations may lead to incorrect results in some cases." implementations must avoid floating-point because rounding errors can give wrong results. So SLH-DSA is used as a whole signature scheme, its components not surfaced as stand-alone interfaces (should not), and its arithmetic kept off floating point (shall not). should not and shall not are not interchangeable here.
en.broken: The limits the retained text states are on the implementation and on the premise. Section 3.2 records the side-channel and fault exposure: "Care must be taken to protect implementations against attacks, such as side-channel attacks or fault attacks [17, 18, 19, 20, 21]." private-key secrecy is critical, so implementations must guard against side-channel and fault extraction. The premise-side limit is in the why claim: security rests on the presumed difficulty of hash-preimage finding, not on a proof reducible to a broadly accepted hard problem. The acknowledged fragility therefore comes from the implementation (side channels and faults) and the assumption (hash resistance), not from any break of SLH-DSA itself recorded in the standard. The shall-not floating-point limit in §3.1 (see the used claim) is of the same kind — it constrains correctness, not an attack outcome; the text is recorded as printed and no `already broken` assertion is made.
en.history: Section 1.2 gives the relation to its candidate lineage. The selection is recorded: "After three rounds of evaluation and analysis, NIST selected the first four algorithms for standardization." and the tie to the round-three submission: "This standard contains several minor modifications compared to Version 3 [4], which was submitted at the beginning of round three of the NIST PQC Standardization process." with the renaming stated: "Throughout this standard, SPHINCS+ will be referred to as SLH-DSA for stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm." The title block prints Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard and Published: August 13, 2024 Effective: August 13, 2024. So the algorithm this dossier describes is the finalized standard form of SPHINCS+, named SLH-DSA, and it is kept separate from the fips205 record that documents the publication; neither is registered as an alias of the other.

zh: stateless hash-based digital signature (SLH-DSA)：以哈希为基、不需维护签名状态的数字签名算法。
SPHINCS+：被 NIST 选作标准化的无状态哈希签名方案，SLH-DSA 由其派生并略作修改。
WOTS+：Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus，一次性签名构件，用于组成 XMSS。
XMSS：eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme，以 WOTS+ 叶与 Merkle 树构成的多次签名方案。
FORS：forest of random subsets，少次签名方案，被 SLH-DSA 用作叶层。
hypertree：XMSS 树的分层树，其签名与 FORS 签名共同组成一个 SLH-DSA 签名。
en: Stateless hash-based digital signature (SLH-DSA): a hash-based digital signature algorithm that needs no signing state to maintain.
SPHINCS+: the stateless hash-based scheme NIST selected for standardization, from which SLH-DSA is derived with minor changes.
WOTS+: Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus, the one-time signature component used to build XMSS.
XMSS: the eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme, a multi-time scheme of WOTS+ leaves and a Merkle tree.
FORS: forest of random subsets, the few-time signature scheme used at the leaves of SLH-DSA.
Hypertree: a layered tree of XMSS trees whose signature, with a FORS signature, forms an SLH-DSA signature.
